glosses: (уложенный) в крупную складку; собранный в сборку; пышный (о платье)

examples.text: Die Ärmel des Kleides sind auffallend bauschig.

glosses: Swollen or inflated in shape, as if filled with air; pillow-like.

examples.text: A puffy fat man in a tracksuit came jogging around the corner.

glosses: Speaking or writing in an exaggeratedly eloquent and self-important manner.

examples.text: There has been much puffy stuff written about whether Lyell's uniformitarianism permitted variations in intensity of causes, or whether he applied his logic in a consistent way, and whether he assumed indefinite stretches of geological time.
